display.title: I Believe in Hashem (Theme Song)
display.summary_short: The short song 'I believe in Hashem, I trust in Hashem' that opens the weekly story programs.
display.summary_long: This is the short theme song heard at the start of the weekly story programs. Its words: 'I believe in Hashem, I trust in Hashem. There never is a moment that I am alone and on my own. I believe and I trust in Hashem, because I understand that He's holding my hand and every step is perfectly planned. He's holding me tight, so I'll be all right. I believe and I trust in Hashem.' In about forty seconds it sums up emunah and bitachon for young children: Hashem is always with us, guiding every step, so there is nothing to fear. It is a simple song that children can quickly learn and sing along with.
display.lesson: Hashem is always with us and every step is perfectly planned, so we can trust Him.

quality.notes: Standalone copy of the theme song that opens the weekly story recordings.
